title: The Claw: Minions of Toil
abstract: A swarm of coding agents will take the shortest path. If that path is sludge, you get sludge at scale. This talk zooms in on the floor those minions stand on: a TypeScript CLI scaffold with written law, an enforceable fence, and Effect so bad input fails loud. Cascadia covered why swarms need a harness. The AIE workshop taught the reliability floor. JoelClaw is what happens when you stop renting the shape of an agent and build the claw yourself. Twenty-five minutes. You leave with a clone command.
